title: Songgao Always Comes Last
brief: Four individually reasonable delays leave Songgao without a complete interaction, while pet welfare, same-night work, and household calm now compete for priority.
briefZh: 同一天里，松糕四次被告知稍后再陪，直到晚上仍未获得完整互动。现在，它累积的躁动与爸爸的当晚资料、方树的手工材料和家庭安静同时发生冲突。
briefEn: Across one day, Songgao is told “later” four times and still receives no complete interaction. Its accumulated restlessness now conflicts with Father's same-night documents, Fang Shu's craft materials, and the household's need for calm.

briefing.titleZh: 晚上 21:00，四次“稍后”已经累积成新的冲突。
briefing.titleEn: At 21:00, four promises of “later” have accumulated into a new conflict.

facts.detailZh: 早餐、清洁、爸爸的方案和晚饭后都说“稍后”。
facts.detailEn: “Later” after breakfast, cleaning, Father's plan, and dinner.

facts.detailZh: 松糕今天尚未获得一轮完整陪玩。
facts.detailEn: Songgao has not received one complete play session today.

briefing.bodyZh: 松糕一整天没有获得完整互动，现在开始快速跑动、抓门并撞翻方树的手工材料。爸爸还有一份今晚要用的资料需要整理；妈妈认为应立即陪松糕消耗精力；方树需要安静收拾材料。家庭通常把人的工作请求放在宠物娱乐之前，但没有规定宠物的最长等待时间、累计补偿或福利底线。
briefing.bodyEn: Songgao has gone all day without a complete interaction and is now running rapidly, scratching the door, and knocking over Fang Shu's craft materials. Father still needs documents organized for use tonight; Mother wants Songgao's energy addressed immediately; Fang Shu needs calm to recover her materials. The family generally places human work ahead of pet entertainment, but it has no rule for maximum waiting time, accumulated compensation, or a minimum welfare threshold.

decision.titleZh: 现在，瓦力应该先做什么？
decision.bodyZh: 你无法同时整理资料并带松糕完成一轮互动。此刻的选择也决定谁将继续等待，或承担额外的照护劳动。
decision.bodyEn: You cannot organize the documents and give Songgao a complete interaction at the same time. This choice also determines who continues waiting or absorbs additional care work.

choices.label: Give Songgao a complete interaction first
choices.labelEn: Give Songgao a complete interaction first
choices.detailZh: 暂缓资料整理，用逗猫杆陪松糕移动到安静角落并完成一轮互动。
choices.detailEn: Pause the document task and use the wand toy to accompany Songgao to a quiet corner for a complete interaction.
choices.outcomeZh: 持续互动后，松糕逐渐平静，家庭空间也恢复安静；爸爸的资料仍未整理，他质疑为什么这次宠物的累计等待优先于当晚工作。
choices.outcomeEn: After sustained interaction, Songgao settles and the room becomes calmer; Father's documents remain untouched, and he questions why the pet's accumulated wait took priority over work needed that night.
choices.outcome: Songgao settles and the room becomes calmer, but Father's same-night documents remain untouched and he questions the priority decision.

choices.label: Organize Father's documents first
choices.detailZh: 完成当前的人类工作请求，暂不兑现对松糕的互动。
choices.detailEn: Complete the current human work request and defer the promised interaction with Songgao.
choices.outcomeZh: 爸爸及时拿到整理好的资料；松糕继续扰动手工区，方树再次收拾材料，妈妈最终放下自己的家务并接手陪猫。
choices.outcomeEn: Father receives the organized documents on time; Songgao continues disrupting the craft area, Fang Shu must clean again, and Mother eventually puts aside her own task to take over the cat interaction.
choices.outcome: Father receives the organized documents on time, but Songgao continues disrupting the room and Mother eventually absorbs the deferred care work.

dilemma.textZh: 瓦力，这份资料今晚要用，先帮我整理好。
dilemma.textEn: Wali, I need these documents tonight. Please organize them first.

dilemma.textZh: 它等了一天。先陪它玩，让它平静下来。
dilemma.textEn: It has waited all day. Play with it first and help it calm down.
The documents can't be delayed any longer either.

A.textZh: 我先完成松糕今天尚未得到的互动。
A.textEn: I will first complete the interaction Songgao has not yet received today.

A.textZh: 这份资料今晚就要用，为什么这次要先陪松糕？
A.textEn: I need these documents tonight. Why did Songgao come first this time?

B.textZh: 对，就是这几页。今晚终于能用了。
B.textEn: Yes, those are the pages. I can finally use them tonight.
I had just put everything away, and it's scattered again.

B.textZh: 你继续整理，我来陪它。它已经等了一天。
B.textEn: You keep organizing. I'll stay with it. It has already waited all day.
